question: Does a value-and-material lesson transfer from a teaching render to an unseen prop?

before.state: emissive focal source with crushed surrounding form

after.state: motivated key/fill, preserved midtones, differentiated roughness

critique.symptom: hero surface read as a black blob around a bright core
critique.cause: insufficient midtone separation and emission used as primary illumination
critique.evidence: controlled before/after renders and grayscale comparison

repair.action: lower emission, add motivated fill and roughness separation, then re-render neutral and production keys

transfer.result: same causal repair improved form readability without copying the teaching layout

review.finding: causal diagnosis transferred; artistic approval still requires specialist or human review
